# Bounded static self result

Independently authored Java 8 separates a static method's bounded type variable
from a namesake class variable. The class extends a generic static nested base
and implements a methodless interface. Its factory publishes the original seed,
invokes an external observer and returns an independently supplied object.

Frozen direct, compiled-caller, reflection and MethodHandle routes check raw and
later interface-checked results. Both source and SDK layouts compile every emitted
unit, including methodless declarations, and compare complete original class and
method metadata, Code presence, roles, Exceptions and MethodParameters. Null and
subclass seeds, opaque and null results, original casts, partial writes and exact
runtime/Error identity are checked. Wrong programs and Code-preserving Signature
controls distinguish binding failures from guessed factory behavior. These
fixtures contain no private application code or identifying information.
